```{r}
# Load in jsonlite package
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
#Assign Node Data and get a snapshot

#datausers_nominal <- stream_in(file("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/user_info.json"))
#head(datausers)
#data_annotate <- stream_in(file(("//Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/annotation_info.json")))
#head(data_annotate)
#songinfo <-  stream_in(file(("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/song_info.json")))
#head(songinfo)
# save(datausers_nominal, data_annotate, songinfo, file = "/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/initialfiles.Rdata" )

# Load in Node data
load("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/initialfiles.Rdata")

# Assign Edge Data
edges_nominal <- read.csv("/Users/alexgould/Desktop/STA585GeniusProject/genius-expertise/follows.csv")

## ---genre first, computed from ALL annotations of every annotator ----

top_tag <- function(x) {
  x <- unlist(x)
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_ else x[1]
}
song_tags <- data.frame(
  key = tolower(songinfo$url_name),
  tag = vapply(songinfo$tags, top_tag, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
song_tags <- song_tags[!duplicated(song_tags$key), ]

annot <- data_annotate[!is.na(data_annotate$user), ]
annot$tag <- song_tags$tag[match(tolower(annot$song), song_tags$key)]
mean(is.na(annot$tag))                 # share of annotations with no genre

mode_tag <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tb  <- table(x)
  top <- names(tb)[tb == max(tb)]
  if (length(top) == 1) top else sample(top, 1)
}
set.seed(585)
user_tag  <- tapply(annot$tag, annot$user, mode_tag)
user_tags <- data.frame(url_name = names(user_tag),
                        tag = as.character(user_tag),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
user_tags <- user_tags[!is.na(user_tags$tag), ]   # genre is required to be in the study

## ---- CHANGED: study population ----
# Annotator with a genre + a profile + observed in the crawl (either column).
# (Old code required BOTH columns, which excluded users who only follow or are only followed.)
in_network <- union(edges_nominal$follower, edges_nominal$following)

study_users <- Reduce(intersect, list(user_tags$url_name,
                                      datausers_nominal$url_name,
                                      in_network))
length(study_users)

# Edges among study users, no self-loops, no duplicate rows
edges_study <- edges_nominal[edges_nominal$follower  %in% study_users &
                             edges_nominal$following %in% study_users &
                             edges_nominal$follower != edges_nominal$following,
                             c("follower", "following")]
edges_study <- unique(edges_study)

# Nodes: ALL study users, isolates included
nodes_one   <- datausers_nominal[!duplicated(datausers_nominal$url_name) &
                                 datausers_nominal$url_name %in% study_users, ]
nodes_study <- merge(nodes_one, user_tags, by = "url_name")

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(nodes_study$url_name),
          nrow(nodes_study) == length(study_users),
          all(unlist(edges_study) %in% nodes_study$url_name))

sort(table(nodes_study$tag), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------

# Split up stats data frame
nodes_study$annotations    <- nodes_study$stats$Annotations
nodes_study$suggestions    <- nodes_study$stats$Suggestions
nodes_study$transcriptions <- nodes_study$stats$Transcriptions
nodes_study$questions      <- nodes_study$stats$Questions
nodes_study$answers        <- nodes_study$stats$Answers
nodes_study$pyongs         <- nodes_study$stats$Pyongs
nodes_study <- subset(nodes_study, select = -stats)

# Roles to boolean variables
all_roles <- sort(unique(unlist(nodes_study$roles)))
for (r in all_roles) {
  col <- paste0("role_", make.names(r))
  nodes_study[[col]] <- vapply(nodes_study$roles, function(x) r %in% x, logical(1))
}
nodes_study <- subset(nodes_study, select = -roles)

# Full graph for modeling: isolates KEPT
g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = edges_study, vertices = nodes_study, directed = TRUE)

c(nodes = vcount(g), edges = ecount(g),
  isolates = sum(degree(g) == 0), loops = sum(which_loop(g)))

## ---- CHANGED: plot only the connected part, report the isolates ----
n_iso  <- sum(degree(g) == 0)
g_plot <- delete_vertices(g, which(degree(g) == 0))   # g itself is untouched

set.seed(585)
lay <- layout_with_fr(g_plot)

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
plot(g_plot,
     layout = lay,
     vertex.label = NA,
     vertex.size = degree(g_plot, mode = "in")/60,
     vertex.color = adjustcolor("darkblue", 0.8),
     vertex.frame.color = NA,
     edge.arrow.size = 0.5,
     edge.color = adjustcolor("grey40", 0.4))
title(sub = paste(n_iso, "isolated nodes omitted from this figure"))

```

Enlarge Plot
```{r network, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, out.width="100%", dpi=150, echo=TRUE}

     vertex.frame.color = NA,

title(sub = paste(n_iso, "isolated nodes omitted from this figure"))
```

Descriptive Analysis
```{r, echo=TRUE}
# A. Node Degree Distribution
hist(log(degree(g, mode = "in")))
table(degree(g, mode = "in"))
hist(log(degree(g, mode = "out")))
table(degree(g, mode = "out"))
mean(degree(g, mode = "in"))
sd(degree(g, mode = "in"))
mean(degree(g, mode = "out"))
sd(degree(g, mode = "out"))

# B. Global and Local Density
#Global
edge_density(g)
#Local (Ego-Network Density)
ego1 <- induced_subgraph(g, c(1, neighbors(g, 1)))
egohalf <- induced_subgraph(g, c(round(vcount(g)/2), neighbors(g, round(vcount(g)/2))))
edge_density(ego1)
edge_density(egohalf)#Must be an Isolate

#C. Clustering Coefficient
hist(transitivity(g, type = "local"))
transitivity(g, type = "global")
mean(na.omit(transitivity(g, type = "local")))
sd(na.omit(transitivity(g, type = "local")))

# D: Average Betweenness
mean(betweenness(g))

#E : Degree/Nominal Assortativity 
#Degree Assortativity
assortativity_degree(g, directed = TRUE)
#Nominal Assortativity 
assortativity_nominal(g,types = as.numeric(factor(V(g)$tag)), directed = TRUE)


#F: Graph Partinitioning 
#cluster_fast_greedy(g)
#Only works on undirected graphs 
#Havent learned a community detection approach for directed so heres one from Claude: 
g_core <- delete_vertices(g, which(degree(g) == 0))   # isolates would each become their own module

set.seed(585)
im <- cluster_infomap(g_core, nb.trials = 10)

length(im); sort(sizes(im), decreasing = TRUE)[1:10]
modularity(g_core, membership(im), directed = TRUE)   # directed modularity

# does the partition line up with genre?
compare(membership(im), as.integer(factor(V(g_core)$tag)), method = "nmi")

```
